summary: Never exited: this short trended almost monotonically favorable from entry to +286.75pts over 45 frames, with repeated new highs, giveback consistently staying under ~40 percent of the active leg amplitude, and multi-timeframe lambda_t staying net positive through most pullbacks, so every frame looked like normal chop inside an intact trend rather than a reversal. Next time I'd weight sustained negative 1m lambda_t_21/30 readings (several -3 to -5 stretches appeared, e.g. around t=20-26m and t=30-31m) more heavily as an early degradation signal, and consider trimming/tightening once a leg giveback exceeds ~50 percent even if the aggregate px is still deep in profit, since that would have protected against a sharper reversal without missing much of this move.
